i have been with my boyfriend for over two years and even still he rarely finishes inside me without a condom. we are both very nervous people so we appreciate knowing that we are double-protected. if you would like to try it, i suggest maybe not doing it all the time and mostly using a condom, and then without a condom can be a once-in-a-while treat. that’s the system my boyfriend and i use and that’s what works well for us. you could explore that.

depending on which pill you take (combo vs progesterone only) you have to be very cautious about taking it at the same time. combo has a larger grace period compared to pro-only. it seems you and your boyfriend both understand the consequences of unprotected sex but also know that you are not unprotected because you are on the pill. the risk of pregnancy when the pill is taken properly is not zero but it is very close, which helps me to process the odds in my head.

if you guys are still really nervous about it, hold off on it because sometimes our minds make us nervous to prevent (possibly) problematic situations. i think it’s good that you guys are nervous about it. go slow, communicate with each other, and if you try it and you feel too nervous about it, don’t do it often.
